predictions: Wow, last week was a tough one. I went 18-9 (which is somehow my worst week of the season so far), but I also hit several scores exactly (including a 1001 winner). Of the 9 I got wrong, 7 of them would have flipped or tied on a single dart, and the other 2 both had shorthanded squads (in F, of course). That honestly doesn't feel that bad at all. All that brings me to 97-38 (71.9% correct) through 5 weeks. Decent.

Match of the week: (A Div.) Jonesing for Mugs @ The Inflationary Element. Jonesing finally brought all their guys, and now they show up in the marquee matchup two weeks in a row. Winner here takes sole possession of the A lead, but it's double-advantage for Jonesing if they win (since they already took down Appetite). Going to be a war once again, but I still have to stick with my guys. Element ekes it out, 13-11.

Match #2: (B Div.) Why So Serious? @ Liquor Possee. Serious sits with the undefeated record, but Possee sits with the point lead so they immediately take first with a win here (well, unless the Kids put up a really huge number tonight). I really think Serious is the class of the division, but for some reason I'm just feelin' the Possee this week, 13-11.

Match #3: (E Div.) Runs with Corks @ What's the Point? Just like the B match above, this is the undefeated leader against the one-loss points leader (but here, the third place team is too far back for any leapfrog shenanigan possibilities). Let's take the leader this time. Point, 13-11.

Match #4: (F Div.) Death Throw @ Cheap Shots. Of course crazy F division is the only division with no undefeated teams through 5 weeks. In fact, these are the only two with fewer than two losses! Winner sits atop the funny farm that is F. Extend the Cheapies' streak to five, 14-10.

Match #5: (E Div.) Shooting Blanks @ Heart of Dartness. If the Corks upend Point in the match above, these two are instantly title contenders again. The Dartness WLWLW cycle says Blanks, but… HoD, 13-11.

Match #6: (C Div.) Darty Little Secrets @ Menace 2 Sobriety. With previously undefeated Menace losing to a 1-win team last week, the Secrets are in position to maybe jump up into 2nd. Secrets in 1001.

Matches #7 & #8: (H Div.) SofaKings @ Dirty Darts (Done Dirt Cheap); Red-eye Rangers @ Double Vision. Sofa and Vision hold a two-match lead on a trio of teams. Here, they could shove two of those chase teams pretty much too far back to catch them. And they do just that. Sofa rolls on, 16-8; Vision's is a bit closer, 14-10.
Match #9: (F Div.) That's What She Said @ Two Time. Two Time dropped a bomb last week, and now these two 2-loss teams are just 1 loss behind the lead pair. Huge matchup here. She Said, 13-11.
Match #10: (A Div.) Darty Minds @ Wing & A Plaque. The next round in "who is one of the entire league's best four teams?" plays out in this one, with Darty Minds fresh off a big win. Darty, 13-11.
Match #11: (E Div.) Off Constantly-Reboot @ Outlaw Arrows. We are down to just two matchups that could guarantee us a first- time winner, and here is the first. Let's fly with the Arrows, 14-10.
Match #12: (F Div.) Down to F, Again @ Shark Shooters. Nope, no clue how this match is for last place. I will never ever understand this edition of F division. I am dooming someone… Shooters, 13-11.
